'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Wirfs DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirfs]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Hunt Down And Throw The Jedi'''. Printed name reads Chris Wirk. Transcription notes: Line 4: only page for this title is the Virtual Set 17 card; V box empty; Line 11: only page for this title is the Virtual Set 17 card; V box empty; Line 20 written ''The Emperor''; Line 45: corrected on the sheet; additional card note reads 45 = Levitation Attack; Line 46 written ''Black Leader''. Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.
